item.title: Measuring and Analysing Sea Levels using Satellites during 2025
item.description: This report presents and analyses the sea level data for 2025. It was a roller coaster year for sea level data that turned into a “Hunt the Data” exercise. As a consequence, the analyses main purpose is to link the new data to the old and produce a new methodology so that changes to sea levels in 2026 can be more easily judged.
